notes.title: New Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][h1][b]New Demo Now Available![/b][/h1][h3][b]Take a peek into the sentient jungle[/b][/h3][p]

[/p][p][b]Hello, friends![/b][/p][p]
[/p][p]We’re thrilled to share that the [b]brand-new Floralis demo[/b] is now live! [/p][p]
[/p][p]Our cinematic puzzle adventure follows a tree-born girl searching for her twin through a sentient jungle grown over the ruins of human civilization. The demo will introduce the first part of her journey.[/p][p]If you played our previous demo, you’ll notice big changes! This includes a completely reimagined look for our heroine herself but also a lot of refinements of puzzles, movement, visuals and gameplay mechanics.[/p][p]🌱 [b]Play the demo now[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707440/Floralis/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]This demo is published as part of [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/UkrainianGames2025"]Ukrainian Games Festival 2025[/url][/u], of which Floralis is a proud participant.[/p][p]Treat your plants kindly! They’ll remember it.[/p][p]SolidCore Games 🌱 [/p][p]
[/p]
